decisions.question: Raise dunning rollout from 25% to 100% before Payments GA?

options.label: Go to 100% now
options.consequence: Recovers about $3.1k MRR a month sooner; no human or security review yet.

options.label: Hold at 25% until review
options.consequence: GA date holds only if the review lands this week.

options.label: Roll back to 0%
options.consequence: Stops the risk; failed payments go back to manual follow-up.

decisions.question: Dunning emails include the last 4 card digits. Allowed under the card data policy?

options.label: Mask fully
options.consequence: Two templates and one test to change; about 40 minutes of agent work.

decisions.question: Tax handling: use the provider's tax API or keep the in-house tables?

options.label: Provider API
options.consequence: Adds a dependency and $0.004 per call; removes 1,900 lines.

options.label: In-house tables
options.consequence: Agents estimate 3 more days; we own the rate updates.

decisions.question: Waitlist promotion caused the incident on Monday. Re-enable for all studios?

options.label: Re-enable
options.consequence: Fix is merged and passing; no load test yet.

options.label: Keep off
options.consequence: Members join the waitlist but are never promoted.

decisions.question: Recurring auto-booking (P0) is not started. Pull two Forge-1 agents off Analytics to start it?

options.label: Move two agents
options.consequence: Analytics exports slip about a week.

decisions.question: Public API has no rate limiting. Block the partner launch until it ships?
Kiosk check-in fails the contrast check on two screens. Accept the agent's proposed palette?

options.label: Accept proposal
options.consequence: Passes AA; buttons change from teal to deep blue.

decisions.question: SMS reminders cost $1,240 a month and rising. Cap per studio?

options.label: Cap at 300 per studio
options.consequence: Saves about $410 a month; 11 studios hit the cap.

options.label: Charge studios for SMS
options.consequence: Needs a pricing change and billing work.

decisions.question: Legacy landing page builder is deprecated but 23 studios still use it. Agents want to delete 6,200 lines.
Referral rewards: credit or cash? Agents need an answer to finish the payout flow.

options.label: Cash via payouts
options.consequence: Needs a security review of the payout path.

decisions.question: Assistant reads member chat history to suggest classes. Allowed by the privacy notice?

options.label: Opt-in only
options.consequence: Lower adoption; agents estimate 20% opt in.

decisions.question: Assistant tone: two drafts of the churn outreach message. Pick one.

options.label: Detailed
options.consequence: Lists the classes the member missed.

decisions.question: 14 flaky e2e tests on class scheduling. Quarantine them so agents can merge?
Database at 78% storage. Upgrade the plan now?

options.label: Archive old events
options.consequence: Agent proposes a job; frees about 30%.

decisions.question: Revenue dashboard: show gross or net of refunds by default?

options.label: Gross
options.consequence: Matches what studios see at the till.

decisions.question: Staff accounts without two-factor: force it on next login?
Pay-rate export has 4 open P2 bugs. Ship to the M2 cohort anyway?
Timetable on mobile: agents propose a week strip instead of a month grid.
Email provider bounced 4% yesterday. Switch the sending domain?
Members ask for family plans (31 requests). Pull them into M3?
Payout reconciliation passes on test data only. Require a run on last month's real payouts?

options.label: Require
options.consequence: One day; needs read access to production payouts.

decisions.question: Accounting sync: two agents wrote competing implementations. Keep which?
Cancellation flow: add a "why are you cancelling" step?
Rotate the payment provider keys before GA?
Landing page for studios: agents generated three hero images. Pick one or ask for more.
Payout job runs at 02:00 and overlaps backups. Move it to 04:00?
Waitlist fix passes, but the load test shows 2.1 s p95 at 500 bookings a minute. Accept?
Agents finished class packs early. Pull class templates forward from M3?

options.label: Keep plan
options.consequence: Agents go to the M2 backlog.

orders.text: Anything touching card or bank data needs a human security review before its flag passes 10%.
No merge below 70% unit coverage on new code.
Every live feature has an alert and a runbook before rollout passes 50%.
Payments GA work goes first; agents may be pulled from M3 and M4.
Kiosk screens must pass AA contrast before review.
A P1 bug stops the feature's rollout automatically.
Daily swarm spend cap: $2,400. Pause research crews first if exceeded.
Assistant features stay behind an internal flag until M3 ships.
